description: Desktop E2E only (debug builds register the plugin; see lib.rs). Split out of `default` and limited to macOS + Linux because tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver (<=1.4.0) pins webview2-com 0.38 / windows 0.61 and does not compile against Tauri 2.12's webview2-com 0.39 on Windows (v1.7.0 desktop release failure). tauri-build skips validating a capability whose `platforms` excludes the target, so the Windows build no longer needs the plugin's permission to exist.
